name: 31294-eaglechain-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE draft head. The target is the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- same weights; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 1200 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm 0.7.3 `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts 512 +- 128 tokens clamped to [256, 768], generations 768 +- 128 clamped to [512, 1024], `ignore_eos` on so every request runs to its sampled length; the clamps keep the worst case (1792 tokens) inside the 2048-token context. No sampling overrides: every request lands on the server's own defaults.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant with a draft model, writing long answers for ten concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped by the reader,
# and the engine would then start without something this directory declares.

# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights; the Llama 3.1 Community
# License applies.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# float16, not the checkpoint's bfloat16: the EAGLE head below is a float16 checkpoint and both
# models are served in one dtype.
dtype: float16

attention-backend: flashinfer

# The draft head declares max_position_embeddings 2048, and sglang gives the draft model the
# TARGET's context length, so the two must agree.
context-length: 2048

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

mem-fraction-static: 0.75
